summary: The Console favicon is now a canvas-generated dot in the pool status color on one reused link rel=icon element, swapped on every applied snapshot alongside the title, with the idle grey dot standing from page load; verified end-to-end in headless chromium against fixture pools in each state (red, amber, green, plus idle grey at boot, and a live amber-to-red swap). bun test and typecheck pass in engine and ui; ui/dist rebuilt.
